prompt: A highly dynamic and lifelike anthropomorphic snow leopard mascot designed for a professional football club. The snow leopard has sleek, vividly textured white fur with blue-gray rosettes and striking icy-blue eyes, symbolizing the team’s colors. Its muscular and agile build is powerful, with proportions resembling a tiger or wolf, exuding strength, speed, and determination. The snow leopard is shown running at full speed on two legs, its athletic body leaning forward in a dynamic pose. Its claws are extended, and its tail flows behind for balance, emphasizing its powerful motion. The snow leopard’s fierce expression features narrowed icy-blue eyes and bared sharp teeth, radiating energy and focus. The snow leopard is dressed in a sleek blue-and-white football uniform, free of logos or emblems, with realistic fabric textures reflecting the bright stadium lights. In one paw, it grips a classic black-and-white European football (soccer ball), charging forward as if ready to strike for a decisive goal. The background showcases the vibrant atmosphere of a roaring stadium, filled with fans waving blue-and-white flags. The dramatic stadium lights cast intense highlights and shadows on the snow leopard, enhancing its powerful presence. Flying confetti and motion blur on the flags add excitement, while the kicked-up dirt and particles beneath its feet emphasize the speed and energy of the scene.
